title.en: Hard cap breach imminent for at least...: manual action needed

titleFormatted.en: Hard cap breach imminent for at least [[seconds]] seconds: no managed devices left to limit

hint.en: Fires when PELS expects a hard cap breach for the chosen time and has no more devices to limit. If power comes from a Flow, report it every 30 seconds. A gap longer than a minute restarts the wait. The [[home]] tag names the affected area.
